question: Will Seoul and Kyiv patch this up, yes or no?

lines.text: South Korea is pulling some of its embassy staff out of Kyiv.
Seoul says Ukraine has taken no constructive action since it recalled its ambassador.

scene.quote: With Ukraine taking no constructive action following the recall of our ambassador

lines.text: The ministry also cites the continued threat of airstrikes across Ukraine.
All consular staff will stay to protect Korean nationals.
Ambassador Park Ki-chang was recalled on 8 October and flew home two days later.
The row began at the UN, when Zelensky said Ukraine had sent two captured North Korean soldiers to South Korea.
They were captured in Russia's Kursk region in January 2025.
Seoul says going public broke a confidentiality deal and put their families in North Korea at risk.
Kyiv says Seoul was told in advance, and that diplomacy must prevail over emotions.
President Lee Jae Myung wants an official apology and has warned of further measures.
Ukraine says it considers the situation resolved.
Seoul and Kyiv estimate North Korea has sent about 15,000 troops to fight for Russia.
Will Seoul and Kyiv patch this up, yes or no?
